certification_name: Red Hat Certified Developer in Cloud-native Applications

domains.name: Implement images using Podman and Containerfile

objectives.title: Understand how to specify the container’s base image.
Understand how to add content to the container.
Understand how to configure the container’s run time environment including user id, working directory and running arbitrary commands.
Understand when and how to expose ports from a Containerfile.
Understand how to pass environment variables and arguments to an image built from a Containerfile.
Understand how to specify the command to be run in a custom image.
Understand container volumes including sharing host data with the container.
Understand the security and permissions requirements related to host and network access from the container.
Understand container and image life cycles and how to manage them.
Push and pull images from and to registries.
Back up an image with its layers and meta data vs. backup a container state.
Listen to container events on the container host.
Understand the description of application resources

exam_name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers – EX188
exam_rules: Performance-based: tasks completed in a live RHEL environment. Access to man pages and documentation is allowed during the exam. No internet access to external sites. No notes or books. All work done in the exam's provided terminal/environment.
id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Name must match Red Hat Learning Subscription / Red Hat customer account exactly.

lifecycle.summary: Red Hat still offers the exam this row's blueprint describes, EX188, now titled 'Red Hat Certified Developer in Cloud-native Applications exam | EX188': 'The Red Hat Certified Developer in Cloud-native Applications exam (EX188) tests your skills and knowledge of the fundamentals of containers, including the ability to find, customize, run, and manage containerized services in stand-alone environments. This exam is based on RHEL10, Podman v5'. The EX288 named by the slug is also live, as the 'Red Hat Certified Advanced Developer in Cloud-native Applications exam (EX288)'. Neither page carries retirement wording.

official_study_resources.notes: Official Red Hat training courses aligned to certification exams
official_study_resources.title: Red Hat Learning Subscription

question_types: Performance-Based (hands-on tasks in live RHEL environment)
recommended_experience: Some experience in the use of a Linux terminal session, issuing operating system commands, and familiarity with shell scripting is beneficial. A Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) certification is recommended but not required.
renewal_options: Red Hat certifications are valid for 3 years. Renew by passing any Red Hat exam tied to the current major version of RHEL, or by passing the same exam again.

retake_policy.notes: No mandatory waiting period between attempts. Full exam fee required for retake.

target_audience: Administrators, architects, software developers, and anyone responsible for creating, managing, or using containers, including those who want to demonstrate their understanding of the key concepts and processes underlying the use of containers in modern software. Developers who wish to containerize software applications. Administrators who are new to container technology and container orchestration. Architects who are considering using container technologies in software architectures. Site reliability engineers who are considering using Kubernetes and Red Hat OpenShift.

testing_centers.notes: Remote kiosk-based exams via Red Hat's own platform. Also available at Red Hat partner test centers.
